title: Please stop flooding our projects with AI slop to furnish your CV
summary: 作者批评开发者为了充实简历而向开源项目大量提交低质量AI生成代码，呼吁停止这种行为，强调质量优先于数量。
highlights: Please stop flooding our projects with AI slop to furnish your CV
AI-generated contributions are polluting open-source repositories
Quality over quantity: maintainers are overwhelmed by low-effort PRs
